meta.name: pi-planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 长任务的关键进度维护成清晰文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常让 AI 处理多步且容易中断的复杂任务。
copy.tagline_en: Keep clear plans and progress across long AI-assisted tasks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you rely on AI to handle complex multi-step projects.

howto.what: 做需要多步骤的任务时,会先在项目里建立并持续更新 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文本文件当作「磁盘记忆」:开工先读旧档恢复上下文,新发现尽快写入文件,每完成一个阶段更新进度、记录错误。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解多步骤项目或研究任务,或预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时触发;/clear 后也会读取规划文件自动恢复。简单问答、单文件修改、快速查询不触发。

say.text: 帮我规划并跟踪这个多步骤项目:用文件建档,每阶段汇报进展。
say.note: 会建立并持续更新三份规划文件。

say.text: 接着做我上一轮没完成的研究,先读回之前的文件再继续。
say.note: 会先读取旧档并恢复现场。

howto.what_en: For complex tasks it creates/reads task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md as permanent on-disk memory in the project; reads them first to restore context, saves discoveries to files, updates progress after each phase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to plan/break down a multi-step project/research, or for work needing 5+ tool calls; after /clear it reads planning files automatically.

say_en.text: Plan and track this multi-step project with files; report progress each phase.
say_en.note: Creates and updates the three planning files.

say_en.text: Continue the research I left unfinished; read back the files first.
say_en.note: Reloads existing planning files before continuing.

say_en.text: Put web findings into findings.md only, not task_plan.md.
say_en.note: External content stays in findings, away from the injected plan.
